user.title: Honda WN7 (WiCAN)
user.description: Enter the MQTT topic prefix your WiCAN publishes the WN7 PIDs to. With the manual AutoPID configuration from the documentation this is wican/honda_wn7.

data_description.topic_prefix: Without a trailing slash and without the PID name, e.g. wican/honda_wn7.
data_description.range_factor: Used for the range estimate. 1.4 km/% was measured on a 2026 EU WN7; lower it for winter or spirited riding.

error.invalid_topic: That is not a valid MQTT topic.
